title: LangQuant: explicit conversational state outside the chat transcript
description: langquant is a scaffold-as-state research artifact that tests whether a fixed-structure, per-turn-refreshed natural-language scaffold can serve as the sole working state for a stateless LLM, with no conversation history in the main-model request. The repository provides the executable mechanism, typed inspectable state, experiment runners, and exploratory local artifacts. Current behavioral scoring and information-flow estimates are documented as limitations rather than validated comparative effects; see docs/EXPERIMENTS.md for the experiment record, run sizes, and the retraction history of the information-flow estimates.
